name: Alienware Battery
author: xyzlab
description: A battery indicator for the Omarchy bar without the power-profiles picker, so it does not fight Alienware thermal profiles. Shows charge, rate, time left, size and cycles, switches thermal profiles through alienwarectl, and can drop the panel refresh rate and the thermal profile when you unplug.

barWidget.description: Battery charge and time left, Alienware thermal profiles, and optional refresh rate and profile switching when the power source changes.
